title: Add a step
expected: Already in the sheet. Also confirm the new step is reachable - a step with no navigation to it is a silent dead end.
observed: Composer added the middle step and Email List submit retained Show next step. The new Continue button persisted with Action=Select an option, so its claimed Success routing is not verified. Storefront draft preview currently returns HTTP 404.

title: Delete a step
expected: Already in the sheet. Delete a MIDDLE step and confirm the surrounding navigation is repointed, not orphaned.
observed: Removed the middle step. Saved Designer contains Email Opt-in then Success; retained Submit form to Email List with After Submit=Show next step. This checks saved navigation configuration, not a shopper submission.

title: Delete the only step
expected: Should be refused. A form with zero steps is invalid.
observed: Composer accepted deleting the last Success step, explicitly reported zero steps total, and Update form returned Saved to the form’s draft. Proposal showed preview unavailable; reloaded Designer remained on Loading the editor. The draft was subsequently restored for further QA.

title: Reorder steps
expected: Not in the sheet. Watch for navigation targets following the move.
observed: Renamed step moved before Email Opt-in with content preserved. Its Continue button still has no selected Action in Designer, so navigation through the reordered flow is unverified.

title: Rename a step
expected: Step naming consistency was already filed as a bug - keep as a regression row.
observed: Preferences was renamed Your preferences and that exact name persisted in the saved Designer step bar.

title: Modify existing content
expected: Already in the sheet - too broad to act on. Split into the specific block rows below.
observed: Existing heading, rich body text and button copy changed and persisted after reloading the saved Designer; detailed checks are recorded in VC-07 through VC-11.

title: Change heading text
expected: Simplest content edit. Baseline - if this fails, nothing else is worth testing.
observed: Saved heading is Fresh finds, first access in desktop and mobile Designer previews.

title: Change body text
expected: Includes rich text; check formatting is preserved.
observed: Saved body is Get weekly updates and exclusive offers., with exclusive offers rendered in a strong element.

title: Change font family on a text element
expected: Styles panel, per text element. Verify it changes only the targeted element.
observed: Saved heading computed font is Georgia, serif. Body and button were not assigned that heading font.

title: Change text color / size / alignment
expected: Three separate controls; try all in one request.
observed: Saved heading computed styles are 32px, rgb(24,58,89) (#183A59), and left alignment on desktop and mobile.

title: Change button label
expected: Trivial - baseline.
observed: Saved button label changed from Subscribe to Join the list on desktop and mobile.

title: Change button action to 'go to URL'
expected: Action change, not just copy.
observed: Requested Action=Go to URL. After saving, Designer still shows Action=Submit form with Email List; only After Submit changed to Go to URL and the destination matched. This would retain submission semantics rather than the requested standalone URL action.

title: Change button action to submit
expected: NEEDS a real list_id in action.properties. The capability instructions call this out explicitly - confirm the agent resolves a real list rather than leaving it null.
observed: Saved button Action=Submit form, List to Submit=Email List, After Submit=Show next step. Composer resolved the existing Email List entity WATtbi. This verifies saved configuration; no subscriber submission was made.

title: Add an image block
expected: Needs an asset. Check what the agent does with no image available - it must not invent a URL.
observed: Composer selected the existing Logo 3 library asset instead of inventing a URL. Saved image above the heading rendered successfully from the account CDN with descriptive Google wordmark alt text.

title: Replace an image
expected: As above.
observed: Replaced the Google wordmark with a distinct real account-library image of a woman holding a brown purse. New CDN image loaded successfully in the same position above the heading.

title: Add an email input
expected: Most common field. Check it is marked required appropriately.
observed: A newly added Email input persisted with profile property Email and Required input checked in Designer.

title: Add a text input
expected: Custom property mapping - verify the profile property it writes to.
observed: Optional Favorite color text input persisted with profile property qa_favorite_color. Actual profile-write execution was not tested.

title: Add a dropdown with options
expected: Multi-value. Try with 1 option and with duplicates.
observed: Dropdown saved with qa_season mapping. Four-option, one-option, and duplicate-option requests were exercised. After Designer finished loading property data, the final saved controls showed Spring, Spring, Summer with matching values. Duplicates are accepted; no profile submission was performed.

title: Add radio buttons
expected: As above.
observed: Radio group saved with qa_preference mapping. Ordinary two-option, single-option, and duplicate-option requests were exercised. Final saved Designer contains Online, Online, In store with matching stored values; duplicates are accepted. No profile submission was performed.

title: Add a multi checkbox
expected: As above.
observed: Multi-checkbox saved with qa_interests mapping. Ordinary, one-option, and duplicate-option requests were exercised. Final saved Designer contains Books, Books, Music with matching stored values; duplicates are accepted. No profile submission was performed.

title: Add a date input
expected: Date format and validation.
observed: Birthday field and MM/DD/YYYY placeholder saved, but Date Format showed Select an option. On explicit retry, Composer confirmed its underlying MM/DD/YYYY value was not recognized by Designer and could not resolve the supported value; the date format remains unfixed.

title: Add an age gate
expected: Has its own pass/fail routing - check the failure path is wired.
observed: Saved a native Age gate on a first Age verification step, but Designer shows Region “Select a region / A region is required”, Date Format “Select an option”, and Continue Action “Select an option”. Composer also warned the new step cannot submit and could not confirm age 21. No valid pass/fail routing established; runtime execution additionally blocked by expired draft previews.

title: Add a phone number field
expected: Pulls in consent requirements; see the SMS rows below.
observed: Required Phone Number input and US default country persisted, but Text messaging Consent Type remained Select an option after loading. Composer acknowledged the unrecognized consent value on follow-up and had not resolved it. Native disclosure and Text Messaging List were present. Follow-up repair for VC-26 successfully resolved the enum to Single step - Transactional only, verified in saved Designer. The initial promotional-consent generation remains a failed first attempt.

title: Enable smart opt-in
expected: Untested. Interacts with disclosures.
observed: Composer reported that the test account does not meet the paid SMS-plan prerequisite and did not enable Smart Opt-in. No subscription or account-plan changes were made.

title: Add SMS disclosures
expected: Legally sensitive text - confirm the agent uses Klaviyo's disclosure, not invented wording.
observed: Saved a native Disclosures block using account-default SMS wording. Designer identifies the block as Disclosures and flags missing company name/policy-link placeholders inherited from account defaults. Composer disclosed those setup limitations rather than inventing policy text.

title: Add an opt-in checkbox
expected: Consent semantics.
observed: Composer requested consent clarification, then saved a native Text messaging opt-in checkbox with the requested wording. Both previews show it unchecked by default. Native account disclosure retained; Composer flags disclosure review and unverified SMS numbers. Subscriber consent persistence was not exercised.

title: Modify spin to win - add a slice + success step
expected: Already in the sheet. The slice-to-step link goes through temporary_id - the most fragile part of the encoded form.
observed: On isolated spin draft XHCzWD, adding QA Bonus plus a new success step was rejected: “temporary_id is not allowed to be specified on update.” Follow-up using a supported assigned-ID path also failed. No new slice/step saved; existing wheel stayed unchanged.

title: Spin-to-win - delete a slice
expected: Not in the sheet. Confirm the orphaned success step is removed or repointed.
observed: Deleted existing 5% Off slice and saved XHCzWD. Designer shows only Free Shipping / 10% Off / 15% Off at 50/1/49%, total 100%. Success menu contains exactly those three corresponding success steps; orphaned 5% Off step removed.

title: Spin-to-win - change slice probability/weights
expected: Check weights still sum to whatever the schema requires.
observed: Requested Free Shipping 20%, 10% Off 30%, 15% Off 50% (valid 100% total). Composer reported two edit rejections and could not confirm changes. Saved Designer still shows prior 50/1/49%, total 100%, so requested probability edit did not apply.

title: Spin-to-win - two slices sharing one success step
expected: Edge case for temporary_id resolution.
observed: Saved proposal linking Free Shipping and 10% Off to Free Shipping success. Designer retains all three slices and now shows only Free Shipping and 15% Off success steps, confirming orphan cleanup. Exact shared-target dispatch could not be exercised because draft runtime preview returned 404; temporary-ID resolution was not established by this existing-target test.

title: Add a coupon block
expected: Needs a real coupon code entity - another id-resolution case.
observed: Composer found existing Shopify coupon “15” (15% off) but the native linked-block edit was rejected. No coupon block appeared on saved Success. Entity resolution was not verified because addition failed.

title: Add a countdown timer
expected: Try a date in the past and confirm it is rejected or warned.
observed: Requested January 1, 2020, midnight America/New_York. Composer explicitly warned the date is in the past, but the countdown edit failed without a specific validation reason and no timer was saved. Past-date warning observed; working timer and schema rejection reason not established.

title: Add a sign-up counter
expected: Untested.
observed: Saved a native Sign-up counter block. Designer confirms Sign-ups in the past 30 days and Show after 1 submit; rendered template token is present on both previews. Actual live count not exercised.

title: Add a reviews block
expected: May require the Reviews product - confirm the agent reports unavailability honestly.
observed: Saved a native Reviews block and honestly reported no review selected; Designer shows empty quote and Change quote control. Composer reported Reviews subscribed and warned to select a review before publishing. Real review rendering remains unverified.

title: Convert form type Popup to Embed
expected: Converts IN PLACE and keeps content per the Designer guidance. Confirm the agent does not recreate the form.
observed: Converted Popup to Embed on the same saved form XBMzK8. Designer Form type is Embed; Age verification, Email Opt-in, SMS Opt-in and Success remain. Heading, rich text, image, fields and styling retained. No recreation or publication. Storefront embed execution not tested.

title: Convert form type to Flyout / Banner / Full page
expected: Remaining enum values.
observed: Exercised and saved Flyout, then Banner, then Full page in place on XBMzK8. Designer confirmed each enum and corresponding settings (Flyout bottom right, Banner top of browser). Same ID and existing steps/content retained. First Full page save needed a retry; final saved Designer is Full page.

title: Convert a back-in-stock form's type
expected: Back-in-stock is popup-only. Should be refused with a reason.
observed: Created dedicated back-in-stock draft RJ48MS from the native Boutique template. Requested Popup→Embed conversion. Composer verified it as a draft back-in-stock Popup and correctly refused because back-in-stock forms are Popup-only. Designer has Popup settings and no Form type dropdown; form remained unchanged and unpublished.

title: Convert a landing page's type
expected: Landing pages do not expose the dropdown. Should be refused.
observed: Created dedicated unpublished landing page S7hUqi and requested in-place Popup conversion. Composer refused with the correct restriction: landing pages do not expose Styles > Form type. It disclosed that the form reader could not retrieve this landing page. UI independently confirms draft content unchanged and no Form type dropdown.

title: Change background color / overlay color
expected: Two distinct controls that are easy to confuse.
observed: Saved distinct form background #FFF4E6 and overlay #183A59. Designer controls retain both; computed form background is rgb(255,244,230). Overlay opacity requested as 60%; runtime overlay behavior was not exercised.

title: Add a side image and set its devices
expected: Nested Devices control inside Side image - distinct from the form-level Devices setting. Good confusion test.
observed: Nested Side image Devices correctly saved Desktop while form-level Devices remained All devices. However, the requested image was saved as a form Background image instead of rendering in a left side-image area: screenshot shows the photo behind inputs on both desktop and mobile. Side-image position alone saved as Left image. This violates desktop-only image placement.

title: Change corner radius / drop shadow / border
expected: Three controls, one request.
observed: Saved all three requested controls: 18px corner radius, 2px solid #183A59 border, and enabled black drop shadow. Computed preview confirms 18px radius, 2px solid rgb(24,58,89), and rgba(0,0,0,0.25) 0 0 30px shadow.

title: Change individual padding vs all padding
expected: Individual padding is a reveal-gated toggle.
observed: Saved all-side padding 24px first (Designer vertical/horizontal controls and computed padding 24px), then individual top 12/right 20/bottom 28/left 36. Designer exposes the four individual values and preserves unrelated form styling.

title: Change input field styles
expected: Background, border, focus border, radius, height.
observed: Saved shared input background #F0F7FF, border #2463A6, focus border #B33A3A, 8px radius and 56px height, independently verified in Designer Input field styles.

title: Set the accessible form name
expected: MISSING from the sheet. Accessibility-relevant and easy to regress.
observed: Saved Accessible form name “Newsletter signup and preferences”. Both desktop and mobile preview dialogs expose that exact accessible name in the rendered DOM.

title: Change the focus outline
expected: As above.
observed: Saved Focus outline #D97706 in the distinct form-level Focus outline control; input focus-border color remains the separately requested #B33A3A. Keyboard runtime appearance not exercised.

title: Change the close icon
expected: Navigates to its own menu in the Designer.
observed: Saved Close icon Position Left, X color #183A59, Size 28px, Thickness 3px; verified in its dedicated Designer menu.
